newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Sao Paulo industrial activity up 13.8 pct in July.
newsitem.headline: Sao Paulo industrial activity up 13.8 pct in July.

text.p: Sao Paulo state's industrial activity rose 13.8 percent in July, compared with the same period last year, the Sao Paulo state Industries Federation (Fiesp) said in a statement.
Fiesp said the increase was mostly due to a higher number of working days in July this year, against the same month of 1995.
It also said July industrial activity last year was unusually low.
Sao Paulo's industrial activity also rose 6.9 percent against the previous month.
Industrial sales jumped 16.3 percent in July against the same month last year and rose 6.0 percent when compared with June 1996, it added.
